release_condition: Release after connector module, CLI/help surface, tests, documentation, task-state/handoff updates are committed and strongest available credential-free validation is recorded.
collision_boundaries: Do not implement a second LLM evaluator, provider runtime, StegGate, TV/TVC credential broker, heartbeat, or Master Records custody authority.
Do not accept, store, print, forward, or require API keys, passwords, Authorization headers, provider tokens, GitHub tokens, or generic credential maps.
Do not modify StegVerse-org/LLM-adapter provider execution files from this claim.
Connection/probe success does not imply downstream execution, governance admission, custody, publication, or product activation.
expected_evidence: CLI help and connect-llm routing validation
explicit submission endpoint bound to canonical /user-llm/v1/user-llm/requests
next_task_after_release: Adapter/Site activation lanes consume the connector without changing their existing runtime authority boundaries.
